about: PowerOnBehaviour RESTORE with LEVEL, on the rgb8 profile (types/0x0020-output.md §2.3): the level before the power cut comes back from `output<ep>` — two bytes for an output with LEVEL, one (on/off) for one without — in the stored colour; the level is stored 5 s after the last change, not at each, so dimming by a held key does not wear the flash out in an evening.

steps.note: dark is stored too: it comes back dark
